nodes.name: BuffData.ts
nodes.summary: Core buff/debuff data layer: defines all buff/debuff definitions (BUFF_DEFS), item/rune/weapon-art buff mappings, perk-to-buff factories (PERK_BUFFS), potency modifiers, and the assembly pipeline that collects, modifies, and converts active buffs for a build. Exports the main assembly function `assembleActiveBuffs` used by the build engine.

functions.name: getWeaponArtBuffs
functions.summary: Returns the granted buffs associated with a given weapon art name from the WEAPON_ART_BUFF_MAP.

functions.name: getTrueBalanceBuffs
functions.summary: Converts active enemy debuffs into corresponding ally buffs via the True Balance perk, grouping by target buff type and taking max potency/duration.

functions.name: applyBuffPerkModifiers
functions.summary: Applies all perk-driven potency and duration modifiers (specific buff mods, Bastion Bless, Trickster reflection, generic debuff mods, Contained, Dark One) to a list of GrantedBuff objects.

functions.name: applyToxinTransferDuration
functions.summary: Adjusts the duration of Toxin Transfer poison buffs to match the self-poison duration plus a flat bonus.

functions.name: convertTailwindToWhirlwind
functions.summary: Converts all Tailwind buffs to Whirlwind when the Whirlwind perk is active, also adding a bleed proc.

functions.name: getBuffDescription
functions.summary: Returns a human-readable description for a buff, substituting potency-based values into template strings.

functions.name: getPerkBuffs
functions.summary: Iterates active perks and calls the corresponding PERK_BUFFS factory to generate GrantedBuff entries.

functions.name: getActiveBuildBuffs
functions.summary: Collects buffs granted by all equipped items (rune, ring, armor, weapon parts, race) by looking up BUFFS_BY_ITEM_SOURCE.

functions.name: applyCauterizeConversion
functions.summary: Marks enemy Burn entries with burnMode='singed' when Cauterize is active and Cursed Flames is not.

functions.name: getBurnApplicationCount
functions.summary: Counts the number of Burn entries in the buff list for Cauterize/Singed damage multiplication.

functions.name: assembleActiveBuffs
functions.summary: Main assembly pipeline: merges item buffs + perk buffs + weapon art buffs, applies perk modifiers, converts Tailwind to Whirlwind, and applies Cauterize conversion.

functions.name: calcBuffEffect
functions.summary: Computes the numeric effect value and unit for a buff given its potency, using the buff definition's effectPerTenthPotency.

functions.name: formatPerkDescription
functions.summary: Substitutes x% placeholders in perk descriptions with computed potency percentages.

nodes.name: TypedDmgBoost.ts
nodes.summary: Calculates per-damage-type damage multipliers and heal multipliers from active buffs and perks (e.g., Glyph Conduit for magic, Rage for physical/magic/water, Photosynthesis for holy/earth in sunlight). Aggregates into a dmgMultByType map.

functions.name: calcTypedDmgBoosts
functions.summary: Computes per-type damage multipliers and a global heal multiplier by evaluating all typed damage boost definitions against active perks, buffs, and context (sunlight, draconic color).

nodes.name: Weaponartcheck.ts
nodes.summary: Validates whether a weapon art's requirements (scaling, stats, weapon type, guild, both-parts) are met by the current build, and produces human-readable lists of unmet requirements.

functions.name: checkWA
functions.summary: Returns true if the weapon art's requirements (guild, weapon type, scaling, stats, both-parts) are fully satisfied by the build.

functions.name: getUnmetReqs
functions.summary: Returns an array of human-readable strings describing which weapon art requirements are not met.

nodes.name: weaponArts.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the WeaponArt and WeaponArtRequirement interfaces and the WEAPON_ARTS data array containing all weapon art definitions with their names, descriptions, cooldowns, damage, scaling, hits, and requirements.

nodes.name: buffs.ts
nodes.summary: Numeric constants for buff/debuff potency, duration, and modifier values used throughout the buff system. Serves as the single source of truth for tuning buff-related game balance numbers.

nodes.name: damage-types.ts
nodes.summary: Defines all damage type metadata (labels, colors), defense inheritance mappings, type priority ordering, and exported constant arrays for the game's 11 damage types (physical, magic, fire, water, earth, air, hex, holy, true, summon, heal).

nodes.name: damageTypeResolve.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves weapon art damage types from string descriptions into numeric type maps, applies type bonuses, and performs damage type conversions (Fire<->Air via Echo Incineration, Air->Magic via Spirit Winds, Dark Magic hex bonus).

functions.name: resolveDamageTypes
functions.summary: Merges base damage types with bonus damage types by summing corresponding keys.

functions.name: applyFireAirConversion
functions.summary: Converts 50% of Fire damage to Air and 50% of Air damage to Fire (Echo Incineration).

functions.name: resolveWaDamageTypeKeys
functions.summary: Parses a weapon art's damage type string ('Same as weapon', 'Highest damage type', or explicit multi-type) into a numeric type map.

functions.name: getFinalWaDmgTypes
functions.summary: Combines resolveWaDamageTypeKeys with resolveDamageTypes to produce the final weapon art damage type distribution.

functions.name: applyAirToMagicConversion
functions.summary: Converts a fraction of Air to Magic (Spirit Winds), then applies Fire<->Air conversion (Echo Incineration), then adds Dark Magic hex bonus from native magic.

nodes.name: _utils.ts
nodes.summary: Minimal utility module exporting round2 and round4 functions for numeric rounding with epsilon correction, used throughout the engine layer.

functions.name: round2
functions.summary: Rounds a number to 2 decimal places with epsilon correction.

functions.name: round4
functions.summary: Rounds a number to 4 decimal places with epsilon correction.

nodes.name: build.ts
nodes.summary: Core build calculation engine: accumulates stats and perks from all equipment slots (race, guild, armor, ring, rune, weapon), applies enchantments and infusions, finalizes perks with effectiveness scaling, computes CDR, boosts, crit, and assembles active buffs. Exports calcBuild as the main entry point.

functions.name: calcBuild
functions.summary: Main entry point: accumulates equipment stats/perks, finalizes perks, and derives the full BuildResult with boosted stats, CDR, boosts, and crit.

nodes.name: data.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-export module that re-exports all symbols from character, equipment, and weapon data sub-modules, providing a single import point for game data accessors.

nodes.name: enchant.ts
nodes.summary: Enchantment application engine: applies stat-selecting enchantments (Restored, Flawless), direct stat modifiers, perk modifiers, perk effectiveness scaling, infusion (50% stat halving), and exclusive enchant slot enforcement.

functions.name: applyEnchantmentsToSlot
functions.summary: Applies a list of enchantments to an equipment slot's base stats and perks, handling stat selectors, direct modifiers, perk modifiers, and upgrade levels.

functions.name: applyPerkEffectiveness
functions.summary: Scales all perks by (1 + PE * 0.1) * (1 + Cursed * 0.1), exempting enchant effects and certain special perks.

functions.name: applyInfusion
functions.summary: Halves all stats from an infused item (50% stat value) while keeping perks unchanged.

functions.name: isExclusiveEnchant
functions.summary: Returns true if the enchantment has stacking='exclusive' (takes over entire slot).

functions.name: enforceEnchantSlot
functions.summary: Enforces slot constraints: deduplicates, handles exclusive enchants, and compacts filled slots.

nodes.name: format.ts
nodes.summary: Formatting utilities for stat display: formats numeric stat values with +/- signs, percentage suffixes for percent-type stats, and converts camelCase stat keys to readable labels.

functions.name: formatStat
functions.summary: Formats a stat value with +/- sign and % suffix for percent-type stats.

functions.name: formatLabel
functions.summary: Converts a camelCase stat key to a readable label (e.g., 'attackSpeed' -> 'Attack Speed').

nodes.name: shrine.ts
nodes.summary: Shrine multiplier system: defines tier-based stat multipliers (3.0x at tier 1 down to 1.0x at tier 5) and applies them to weapon stats and scalings when the shrine is active.

functions.name: applyShrineToScalings
functions.summary: Multiplies all scaling values by the shrine tier multiplier.

functions.name: applyShrineToStats
functions.summary: Multiplies all stat values by the shrine tier multiplier with rounding.

nodes.name: weapon.ts
nodes.summary: Weapon calculation engine: combines blade/handle (or glove/essence for monk) stats, scalings, damage types, and perks; resolves weapon type from handle+blade combo with perk overrides; detects hybrid bonus; applies shrine multipliers and monk rank bonuses. Exports calcWeapon and calcMonkWeapon.

functions.name: calcWeapon
functions.summary: Calculates the full WeaponResult for a standard (non-monk) weapon from blade and handle names, including merged stats, scalings, damage types, weapon type resolution, and hybrid detection.

functions.name: calcMonkWeapon
functions.summary: Calculates the full WeaponResult for a monk weapon from glove and essence names, applying monk rank stat bonuses on top of shrine-scaled stats.

nodes.label: DoTDamage
nodes.description: DoT (Damage over Time) calculation module. Defines DoT types (Bleed, Burn, Poison), stat scalings, damage type mappings, and functions for computing DoT tick damage, potency multipliers, and display potency with Endless Despair modifier.

nodes.label: DOT_TYPE_LIST
nodes.description: ReadonlyArray of DoT type names: 'Bleed', 'Burn', 'Poison'

nodes.label: DOT_SCALINGS
nodes.description: Stat scaling definitions per DoT type. Bleed=dexterity+physical, Burn=fireĂ—1.5, Poison=hex+earth, Caustic Slow=hex+earth

nodes.label: DOT_DMG_TYPE_MAP
nodes.description: Maps each DoT type to the damage type used for defense mitigation (Bleedâ†’physical, Burnâ†’fire, Poisonâ†’hex, Caustic Slowâ†’true)

nodes.label: getDotBase
nodes.description: Returns flat base damage before potency multiplier. Formula: DOT_BASE_DAMAGE Ă— (1 + inflictionPotency / DOT_INFLICTION_DIVISOR)

nodes.label: getDotPotencyMult
nodes.description: Returns potency multiplier: (1 + dotPotency)^(1 + min(1, dotPotency)). Exponent caps at 2 when dotPotency >= 1.0

nodes.label: calcDotTick
nodes.description: Computes a single DoT tick for given dotPotency and inflictionPotency. Combines getDotBase and getDotPotencyMult with rounding.

nodes.label: toGamePotency
nodes.description: Converts builder-display perk value to game-internal value (Ă—0.1)

nodes.label: calcDotDisplayPotency
nodes.description: Computes effective DoT display potency applying Endless Despair modifier when present

nodes.label: HealBoost
nodes.description: Heal boost multiplier calculation module. Defines healing sources (perks, runes, weapon arts, passives) and computes the combined heal multiplier by iterating over HealBoostDef entries, applying conditions, and multiplying results. Handles level healing, Emotional, Heal Boost, Oceans Rage, Vampire sunlight, Frenzy self, Dragon Infusion holy, and Anti Heal reduction.

nodes.label: HealSource
nodes.description: Union type for healing sources: 'perk' | 'rune' | 'weaponArt' | 'passive'

nodes.label: HealBoostContext
nodes.description: Context for heal boost calculation containing perks, emotional state, darkness, level, draconic color, slider value, guild, rage potency, and active buffs

nodes.label: HealBoostResult
nodes.description: Result of heal boost calculation with individual entries and final multiplied multiplier

nodes.label: calculateHealBoost
nodes.description: Calculates combined heal boost multiplier from all active sources. Iterates over HealBoostDef entries, applies conditions and custom calcFns, multiplies all raw multipliers, and applies Anti Heal self-debuff reduction.

nodes.label: Perkbasedmg
nodes.description: Perk-based damage definitions. Large module defining ~30+ perk damage effects (Springblast, Bastion Ballista, spirits, Dragon State, Dragon Claw/Bubble, Volatile Shell, Dark Harvest, Pyre Bloom, etc.) with HP gate logic, secondary effects, trigger chains, proc coefficients, and dynamic damage type/scaling resolution.

nodes.label: gateThreshold
nodes.description: Returns the HP threshold for a gate, returning undefined if the perk amount meets alwaysActiveAtPerkAmount

nodes.label: isHpGateActive
nodes.description: Determines if an HP gate is active based on hpFillPct, perkAmount, and gate direction (aboveThreshold/belowThreshold)

nodes.label: DRAGON_STATE_HP_GATE
nodes.description: HP gate for Dragon State: 80% threshold (above), dynamically reduced by perk stacks

nodes.label: SECONDARY_TONE_COLORS
nodes.description: Color mapping for secondary effect tones: defense=#f87171, offense=#fb923c, utility=#8a8d85

nodes.description: Calculates Springblast base damage from perk amount using constants SPRINGBLAST_BASE_HIT, PER_STACK_HIT, MULT_PER_STACK

nodes.label: calcBomberChargeBaseDamage
nodes.description: Calculates Bomber Charge base damage factoring in missing HP percentage with a cap

nodes.label: PERK_DMG_DEFS

nodes.label: findPerkDmgDef
nodes.description: Looks up a PerkDmgDef by perk name and optional label from the internal map

nodes.label: Runebasedmg
nodes.description: Rune-based damage definitions. Defines damage for 14 rune types (Ancient Cleric, Beenade, Boostshroom, Thunderous Charge, Sporeling Toss, Foot Dive, Caci, Cacitrops, Hex Web, Brainblast, Fireball, Rocky Tail, False Sun, Snoeball) with slider-based and potency-based hit counts, shield defs, and heal-only runes.

nodes.label: RUNE_DMG_DEFS
nodes.description: Array of RuneDmgDef objects defining damage, types, scalings, hit counts, notes, sliders, and shields for each rune

nodes.label: SummonData
nodes.description: Summon data module. Defines summon stat calculation, max summon count (base 15 + Swarm perk), summon definitions (Mage Bomber, Blessedling), WA-to-summon name mapping, and summon perk definitions.

nodes.label: calcSummonStat
nodes.description: Calculates summon stat: base Ă— (1 + (summonBoostPct/100) Ă— (1 + level/MAX_LEVEL)), rounded to 2 decimals

nodes.label: calcMaxSummonCount
nodes.description: Returns max summon count: 15 + floor(Swarm perk amount)

nodes.label: SUMMON_MAP
nodes.description: Map of summon name to SummonDef objects (Mage Bomber, Blessedling)

nodes.label: WA_SUMMON_MAP
nodes.description: Mapping from weapon art summon names to base summon names

nodes.label: cdr
nodes.description: Cooldown reduction perk data module. Defines CDR entries for perks: Caster, Channeled Weapon, Mage Rage, Poison Acceleration, Runic Winds, Wave Rider, Whirlwind, Gladiatorial Rage, and Voltaic Body with rune/WA percentage reductions, multipliers, filters, and toggle flags.

nodes.label: CDR_PERK_DATA
nodes.description: Record mapping perk names to PerkCDREntry objects with runePct, waPct, runeMultiplier, waMultiplier, runeSetCD, filters, and toggleable flag

nodes.description: Defensive perk calculations. nodes.description: Returns array of active defensive perk sources given current game state (perks, HP, conditions). Filters by HP thresholds, darkness, rage, mount, shield, and debuff count.

nodes.label: calcDefensivePotencyMult
nodes.description: Calculates defensive potency multiplier from Bastion Bless stacks and Draconic Holy Infusion

nodes.label: Boost.ts
nodes.description: Defines the damage boost calculation system for the Voxel Blade build calculator. Contains BoostDef/BoostContext interfaces and a comprehensive BOOST_DEFS array of 30+ damage boosts (Blood Thirsty, Frenzy, Primal, Penance, Vampire, etc.), each with either simple multiplier-per-perk values or complex custom calcFn closures. Also exports helper functions calcMinionAbsorptionPotency and calcFrenzyPct, and Penance bleed constants.

nodes.label: calcMinionAbsorptionPotency
nodes.description: Calculates the potency of Minion Absorption based on summon boost percentage and stack count. Returns a rounded decimal representing the damage boost multiplier.

nodes.label: calcFrenzyPct
nodes.description: Calculates the Frenzy damage percentage by combining the base frenzy value with a rage-potency-scaled multiplier.

nodes.label: PENANCE_HP_THRESHOLD

nodes.description: Context object passed to complex boost calcFn functions. Contains player state (perks, crit chance, jump boost, rage potency, HP fill, enemy HP, etc.) needed to evaluate conditional boosts.

nodes.label: BoostDef
nodes.description: Definition structure for a damage boost. Supports simple multiplierPerPerk boosts, complex calcFn-based boosts, attack-type filtering (appliesTo), proc coefficient scaling, and user-facing toggles.

nodes.label: BOOST_DEFS
nodes.description: Array of all 30+ damage boost definitions. Each entry describes a boost source (perk name, level, etc.), its type (dmg/heal), how it scales, conditions, and attack-type applicability.

nodes.label: DebuffCombatEffect
nodes.description: Structure defining a debuff's combat impact: a description function, optional damage multiplier, optional defense reduction across 8 stat types, and optional element-specific damage multipliers.

nodes.label: DEBUFF_COMBAT_EFFECTS
nodes.description: Record<string, DebuffCombatEffect> mapping 9 debuff names to their combat effect definitions. Covers Weakness, Shatter, Sticky (4 variants), Electrical Rend, Despair, Frostbite, and Hypnotized.

nodes.label: enemyHpEffects.ts
nodes.description: Defines HP-gated enemy effects that trigger based on enemy current HP percentage. Contains interfaces for HP gates, debuff effects, and DoT boosts, plus a static ENEMY_HP_EFFECT_DEFS array (currently Mycotic Bloom). Exports functions getActiveEnemyHpDebuffs and getEnemyHpDotMultiplier to evaluate which effects are active given the current enemy HP and active debuffs.

nodes.label: EnemyHpGate
nodes.description: HP threshold gate: hpThreshold (percentage) and aboveThreshold (above or below).

nodes.label: EnemyHpDebuffEffect
nodes.description: Defines a debuff that gets applied based on enemy HP gate: buffName, potency function, and duration.

nodes.label: EnemyHpDotBoost

nodes.label: EnemyHpEffectDef
nodes.description: Complete definition of an enemy HP-gated effect: perk name, condition description, HP gate, optional required debuff, optional debuff grant, optional DoT boost.

nodes.label: getActiveEnemyHpDebuffs
nodes.description: Evaluates all ENEMY_HP_EFFECT_DEFS and returns debuffs whose HP gates and prerequisite debuffs are met given current perks, enemy HP, and active debuffs.
nodes.signature: (perks: Record<string, number>, enemyHpFillPct: number, activeDebuffNames: string[]) => Array<{ buffName, potency, duration, condition, sourceName }>

nodes.label: getEnemyHpDotMultiplier
nodes.description: Returns the cumulative DoT damage multiplier from all active enemy HP-gated dot boosts for a given dot type.
nodes.signature: (perks: Record<string, number>, enemyHpFillPct: number, dotType: string) => number

nodes.label: perkAutoDebuffs.ts

nodes.label: PerkDmgTypeBonusDef
nodes.description: Definition for a perk that grants bonus damage of a specific element type. Supports fixed or dynamic type, fixed or computed amount-per-stack, conditional activation, and proc exemption.

nodes.description: Array of 4 perk damage type bonus definitions: Void Rage (hex, conditional on rage), Channeled Weapon (magic), Emotional (fire, conditional on debuffs state), Draconic Blood (dynamic type, conditional on draconic infusion).

nodes.signature: (includeNoProcExempt: boolean, ctx: { perks, ragePotency, draconicRuneInfusion, emotionalState, draconicColor, guild, draconicInfusionDisabled, toxinTransferHexBonus, rageDisabled }, excludePerks?: Set<string>) => Record<string, number>

nodes.description: Defines conditional damage boosts applied to specific weapon types when matching perks and hit scopes (M1 finisher or M2). Iterates over a static list of boost definitions and accumulates a combined multiplier.

nodes.label: getWeaponConditionalBoost
nodes.description: Given perk levels, a weapon type, and a hit scope, returns the combined damage multiplier and labels of all matching conditional boosts. Each matching boost applies multiplicatively: mult *= 1 + multiplierPerPerk * perkStacks.
nodes.signature: getWeaponConditionalBoost(perks: Record<string, number>, finalWeaponType: string, hitScope: WeaponHitScope): { mult: number; labels: string[] }

nodes.label: WeaponHitScope

nodes.label: WeaponConditionalBoost
nodes.description: Internal interface describing a single conditional boost definition: the perk name, multiplier per stack, applicable weapon types, hit scope, and a human-readable condition string.

nodes.label: WEAPON_CONDITIONAL_BOOSTS
nodes.description: Static array of WeaponConditionalBoost definitions. Currently contains two entries for the 'Aggressive Personality' perk â€” one for War Hammer/Dual Mallets M1 finisher and one for Mallet M2.

nodes.label: crit.ts
nodes.description: Core critical hit calculation engine. Computes natural crit chance, extra crit chance, combined effective crit chance, and crit damage multiplier from stats and perks. Handles Primal division, proc coefficient scaling, and sources for both crit chance and crit damage.

nodes.label: calcCrit
nodes.description: Main critical hit calculator. Aggregates natural crit sources (dexterity, elemental boosts, Perfection, Seismic Momentum), extra crit sources (Carrying Winds, King's Luck), and crit damage sources. Applies Primal division to natural sources when active. Computes combined crit chance via independence formula and adjusts for proc coefficient scaling. Returns a comprehensive CritResult with breakdowns for UI display.
nodes.signature: calcCrit(stats: StatMap, perks: Record<string, number>, hitProcCoeff?: ProcCoefficient): CritResult

nodes.label: calcDexterity
nodes.description: Converts dexterity boost stat to a crit chance percentage by dividing by DEX_CRIT_DIVISOR and rounding.

nodes.label: calcElementalBoost
nodes.description: Generic helper for elemental crit sources. Multiplies a stat value (e.g., airBoost) by a per-stack multiplier and the number of perk stacks, returning 0 if the stat is non-positive.
nodes.signature: calcElementalBoost(perks: Record<string, number>, perkName: string, statValue: number | undefined, multiplier: number): number

nodes.label: calcPerfection
nodes.description: Calculates crit chance from Perfection perk stacks (stacks * PERFECTION_CRIT_PER_STACK).

nodes.label: hasActiveGatingPerks
nodes.description: Returns true if any source in the given array has at least one gating perk with stacks > 0.
nodes.signature: hasActiveGatingPerks(sources: CritSource[], perks: Record<string, number>): boolean

nodes.label: round (crit)
nodes.description: Local rounding helper: rounds to 2 decimal places.

nodes.label: CritResult
nodes.description: Comprehensive return type from calcCrit. Contains natural and extra crit chances, effective crit chances with/without proc scaling, crit damage multiplier, breakdown arrays for all sources, Primal state, formula string, and optional proc scaling info.

nodes.label: CritSource
nodes.description: Describes a single source of crit chance or crit damage: a label, a calculation function, optional gating perks that must be active, and whether the source counts as a natural equivalent for Primal scaling.

nodes.label: NATURAL_CRIT_SOURCES
nodes.description: Array of crit sources that count as 'natural' and are affected by Primal division: Dexterity Boost, Seismic Momentum, Flowing Crits, Spell Slinger, Sharp Crits, and Perfection.

nodes.label: EXTRA_CRIT_SOURCES
nodes.description: Array of crit sources that are independent of natural sources and combined via the independence formula: Carrying Winds and Caci King Spirit (King's Luck).

nodes.label: CRIT_DMG_SOURCES
nodes.description: Array of sources contributing to the crit damage multiplier: Thief Training, Dexterity, Seismic Momentum, all elemental crit sources, Venom Eater, Vital Strikes, Spark, Critical Master, and Splinter.

nodes.label: ELEMENTAL_CRIT_SOURCES
nodes.description: Shared array of elemental crit sources (Flowing Crits, Spell Slinger, Sharp Crits, Perfection) used in both natural crit chance and crit damage calculations.

nodes.label: ALL_CRIT_SOURCES
nodes.description: Concatenation of NATURAL_CRIT_SOURCES, EXTRA_CRIT_SOURCES, and CRIT_DMG_SOURCES, used by hasActiveGatingPerks to check for any crit-relevant perks.

nodes.label: CRIT_DISABLED_PERKS
nodes.description: List of perk names that disable crit calculations: 'Seismic Momentum' and 'Fractured Energy'.

nodes.label: defense.ts
nodes.description: Defense calculation module. Resolves defense sources (percent-based and flat) into damage multipliers, groups damage types by which defense stats apply, and computes total base armor defense percentage.

nodes.label: resolveDefenseSources
nodes.description: Separates defense sources into percent-based and flat categories, computes individual multipliers and true DR percentages, then multiplies them within each category to produce combined percentMultiplier, flatMultiplier, and a finalMultiplier.

nodes.label: calcBaseArmorDefPct
nodes.description: Looks up the relevant defense stat keys for a given damage type from DEF_GROUP, sums them from the stats record, and returns the total defense percentage.
nodes.signature: calcBaseArmorDefPct(dmgType: string, stats: Record<string, number>): number

nodes.label: calcDefMultiplier
nodes.description: Converts a defense percentage to a damage multiplier. Positive def gives 1/(1+def) (damage reduction); negative def gives 1+|def| (damage amplification).

nodes.label: calcTrueDrPercent
nodes.description: Computes the true damage reduction percentage from a defense stat: def/(1+max(def,0)), displayed as a percentage.

nodes.label: DefenseSource
nodes.description: Input interface for a single defense source with a name, defense percentage, optional flat flag, and optional condition string.

nodes.label: ResolvedDefenseSource
nodes.description: Extended DefenseSource with computed damage multiplier and true DR percentage.

nodes.label: DefenseBreakdown
nodes.description: Result of resolveDefenseSources: lists of resolved percent and flat sources, their combined multipliers, and the final combined multiplier.

nodes.label: DEF_GROUP
nodes.description: Mapping from damage type strings (physical, air, earth, fire, water, hex, holy, magic, true, summon) to the defense stat keys that reduce that damage type. True and summon have no defense sources.

nodes.label: utils.ts
nodes.description: Shared utility functions used across the calculation engine and UI. Provides multiplier rounding, warding debuff multiplier calculation, text highlighting for search, and proc chance computation with different scaling modes.

nodes.label: roundMultiplier
nodes.description: Rounds a multiplier to 4 decimal places to avoid floating-point precision issues in stacked multiplicative calculations.

nodes.label: calcWardingDebuffMultiplier
nodes.description: Computes the damage multiplier from warding. Positive warding reduces damage via 1/(1+wardingPct); negative warding amplifies via 1-wardingPct.

nodes.label: highlightTextParts
nodes.description: Splits text into an array of {text, highlight} parts based on case-insensitive substring matching of a query. Used by UI components to render search highlights without raw HTML.
nodes.signature: highlightTextParts(text: string, query: string): Array<{ text: string; highlight: boolean }>

nodes.label: calcProcChance
nodes.description: Pure utility to compute actual proc chance from a base chance, a hit's proc coefficient, and a scaling mode. 'normal' multiplies directly, 'positiveOnly' only buffs (never debuffs), 'ignore' returns base chance unchanged. noProc coefficient returns 0 for normal scaling but preserves base for positiveOnly.
nodes.signature: calcProcChance(baseChance: number, procCoeff: ProcCoefficient, scaling: ProcScalingType): number

nodes.label: calculateMultiplierFromPct
nodes.description: Converts a percentage to a multiplier: (1 + pct/100), rounded to 4 decimal places.

nodes.label: multiplyMultipliers
nodes.description: Reduces an array of multipliers into a single product starting from 1.0.

tour.title: Application Bootstrap
tour.description: The app starts at src/main.ts, which mounts the Svelte 5 App component to the DOM and injects Vercel analytics. This is the single entry point for the entire application.

tour.title: Type Definitions & Data Contracts
tour.description: src/lib/types.ts defines all core TypeScript types â€” StatKey, StatMap, BuildState, Race, Guild, Armor, Ring, Rune, Enchantment, and Perk. These types are the shared contracts between the UI, state, and engine layers. The file also contains the applyUpgrade utility and STAT_KEYS/UPGRADE_MAX constants.

tour.title: Reactive State Management
tour.description: src/lib/store.ts creates a Svelte writable store for the entire BuildState (race, guild, equipment, enchantments, upgrades, etc.) with localStorage persistence. It exposes a derived 'result' store that runs calcBuild() whenever the build changes, plus helper functions like setEnchantment, moveArmorSlot, and moveRingSlot for safe state mutations.

tour.title: Game Data Definitions
tour.description: Data files define the game's entities: races/guilds/perks (character.ts), armors/rings/runes/enchantments (equipment.ts), and weapon blades/handles/gloves/essences (weapons.ts). These all import from JSON data files (races.json, blades.json, etc.) and export lookup functions like getRace, getBlade, getEnchant. Additional data modules define buffs (BuffData.ts), damage boosts (Boost.ts), DoT damage (DoTDamage.ts), perk/rune base damage (Perkbasedmg.ts, Runebasedmg.ts), summon stats (SummonData.ts), and weapon arts (weaponArts.ts).

tour.title: Engine Sub-modules
tour.description: The engine is split into focused modules: weapon.ts calculates base weapon damage from blades/handles/gloves/essences; enchant.ts applies enchantment stat modifiers and infusion bonuses; shrine.ts applies shrine multipliers to stats; format.ts provides stat formatting helpers; _utils.ts contains internal rounding utilities. The engine barrel (engine.ts) re-exports all of these.

tour.title: Core Damage Calculation Pipeline
tour.description: src/lib/engine/build.ts is the heart of the application. Its calcBuild() function orchestrates the entire damage pipeline: it resolves race/guild effects, assembles stats from equipped armor/rings/runes, applies enchantments and shrine multipliers, calculates weapon damage (normal + monk), computes critical hit chances via crit.ts, applies defense multipliers via defense.ts, processes all boost multipliers (level, emotional state, buffs, perks), calculates cooldown reductions, and resolves damage types. It pulls in BuffData, DoTDamage, Perkbasedmg, Runebasedmg, SummonData, and more to produce the final result.

tour.title: UI Component Layer
tour.description: The presentation layer is built with Svelte 5 components. App.svelte is the monolithic main component (~1100+ lines) containing all build selection UI, drag-and-drop armor/ring management, modal systems, and stat display. It imports directly from the engine barrel and store. Supporting components include DamageAnalyzer (damage breakdown analysis), BaseDamageCalc (base damage display), BuffList (active buff display), BuildSaves (save/load builds), and modals like WeaponPartModal for equipment selection.

tour.title: Data Flow Summary
tour.description: The full data flow: main.ts mounts App.svelte â†’ App reads/writes the build store (store.ts) â†’ store's derived 'result' calls calcBuild() in engine/build.ts â†’ calcBuild aggregates data from engine/data/*, engine/weapon.ts, engine/enchant.ts, engine/shrine.ts, crit.ts, and defense.ts, plus game data from data/* modules â†’ the computed result flows back reactively to App.svelte for display. The store auto-persists to localStorage.
